P0007.original: Leadership takes shape in how we show up for others. Every role at Texas A&M offers a chance to earn trust, help someone grow and move meaningful work forward.

P0014.original: A colleague needs a clear answer. A new employee needs a welcome. A team needs someone to listen, make a decision or carry an idea forward. These are everyday opportunities to lead.

P0015.original: Whether you teach, advise, conduct research, support operations or supervise a team, your work connects to people who count on Texas A&M. Leading the Aggie way means considering those people, taking responsibility and helping others succeed.
